# Druid (`monsters:druid`)
*Medium or small humanoid, neutral* | **CR** 2 (XP 450; PB +2)
**AC** 13 ([Studded Leather Armor](../equipment/studded-leather-armor.md)) | **HP** 44 (8d8 + 8) | **Speed** 30 ft.
**STR** 10 (+0) | **DEX** 12 (+1) | **CON** 13 (+1) | **INT** 12 (+1) | **WIS** 16 (+3) | **CHA** 11 (+0)
**Skills:** [Skill: Medicine](../proficiencies/skill-medicine.md) +5, [Skill: Nature](../proficiencies/skill-nature.md) +3, [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +5
**Senses:** Passive Perception 15
**Languages:** Common, Druidic, Sylvan
**Gear:** Studded Leather Armor

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.
- **Vine Staff.** Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
- **Verdant Wisp.** Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 90 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.
- **Spellcasting.** The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
  - At will: [Druidcraft](../spells/druidcraft.md), [Speak with Animals](../spells/speak-with-animals.md) (level 1)
  - 2/day: [Entangle](../spells/entangle.md) (level 1), [Thunderwave](../spells/thunderwave.md) (level 1)
  - 1/day: [Animal Messenger](../spells/animal-messenger.md) (level 2), [Longstrider](../spells/longstrider.md) (level 1), [Moonbeam](../spells/moonbeam.md) (level 2)
